Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Pankaj Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State and also perused the record.
3.

The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to FIR/Case Crime No. 345 of 2022, under Sections 376, 323, 506 I.P.C., P.S.- Govind Nagar, District- Kanpur Nagar.

4. After arguing for some time, applicant's counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be disposed of with a direction to file a regular bail application which may be Avinash Gautam vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170381033/
1 decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2022 SCC Online SC 825.
5.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2022 SCC Online SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for the applicant.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference u/

The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with a direction that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned court within one month from today and in case, a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
7. For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the concerned court, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant, in the above case.

(Justice Krishan Pahal) Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Shalini  Avinash Gautam vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170381033/
